title: Frame Motion Sequence
description: A reference-led sequence for lyric-visualizer frames that locks one motion grammar, one atmosphere, and one non-readable glyph system across related shots.
creative_direction: The root frame establishes a music-visualizer language built from cinematic stills, motion streaks, waveform geometry, and invented glyph zones. The following images preserve the same framing grammar and pseudo-typographic rhythm while changing emotional intensity and environmental treatment.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-echo-frame first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-rainfall-chorus, 03-whisper-bridge, 04-finale-surge. Queue may run 02-rainfall-chorus, 03-whisper-bridge, 04-finale-surge concurrently after 01-reference-echo-frame is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
